t: Caesarean section of Misgav Ladach: comparison with the Pfannenstiel technique at the Brazzaville University Hospital Center.
Comparative study of laparoscopic surgery end laparotomy for management of ectopic pregnancy in University Hospital of Brazzaville Congo.
a: Objectives: To appreciate feasibility, efficiency and advantages of caesarean section by Misgav Ladach while compared to the classical Pfannenstiel procedure. Patients and methods: We conducted a randomized study in the obstetrics and gynaecology department at University Centre hospital of Brazzavil

Objective: This study examined the advantages of laparoscopic surgery compared to laparotomy for the management of ectopic pregnancy.
